A.notes: A has a complete authorial idea: the house plan, the moving light/daytime control, the brick palette and the courtyard language all reinforce the brief from hero through projects to process. Typography is the identity and the scroll-strip shows motion progressing with the light control in a way that serves the concept; I cannot judge easing from frames, but the sequence is clear. Minor deduction on craft because the mobile metadata/control area looks a bit cramped.

B.notes: B opens with a strong brick-and-courtyard motif and a confident editorial mood, but the idea is carried less consistently through the long project list and later sections. The type is elegant and the drawings are clean, yet the scroll-strip shows little evidence of motion doing conceptual work beyond basic reveals/section changes; from still frames I would not reward more. Overall it is polished and accessible, just less distinctive and less narratively animated than A.

raw.why: A is the more complete and memorable design system, with a stronger concept, more distinctive signature, and motion that visibly supports the light/courtyard idea.
